name: EP Booster

dims.source: Official Xotic product page via data/spec_sheets_staging.json (verified): 'Dimensions (W/D/H): 3.5 x 1.5 x 1.5 in (89 x 38 x 38 mm)' with W/D labels rotated relative to physical orientation; remapped w=left-right 1.5 in, d=front-back 3.5 in, h=1.5 in bare enclosure adopted (knob inclusion unknown; see references/xotic-ep-booster_measurements.md)

enclosure.note: Custom mini box 38 x 89 x 38 mm; no PRESETS entry fits. Per-model dims override. Black top, charcoal brushed sides on the real pedal rendered as single near-black powder coat.

knobs.note: Single clear gain knob centred. Two-view: topdown z -0.88, front render z -0.98 (see measurements). Clear acrylic on the real pedal; library mxr Davies scaled to measured ~0.76 in dia. No tick ring on the real pedal.

led.note: Blue status LED centred below the knob. Two-view blue-core centroid z -0.283 in both topdown and front (see measurements). Library led() is red; hero page retints blue locally.

footswitch.note: Round chrome true-bypass stomp centred. Two-view: topdown z +1.26, front z +1.14 (see measurements).

jacks.note: INPUT on right wall, rear jack. Two-view z -0.28/-0.34 (see measurements). y mid-wall provisional.
OUTPUT on left wall, forward of INPUT. Photo z +0.39 dominates squashed render +0.19; provisional +/-0.10 in (see measurements).

powerJack.note: 9V round barrel centred on back wall under the + -C- - print (parts diagram + detail6). y provisional single-view.

labels.note: DC polarity print centred on back edge (both top views).
Large brush script EP centred (detail1). Vector script approximation; letterform differs from the hand-drawn original.
Small sans under -booster; xotic lower-case as printed.
Vertical IN print on right edge by INPUT jack (rot -90deg so it reads unmirrored from above; +90deg mirrored in Top view).
Vertical OUT print on left edge by OUTPUT jack.

notes: Xotic EP Booster mini hero. Custom mini box (38 x 89 mm); all deck parts seat via surfaceAt() on the flat deck (h=1.50) - no hardcoded y on knob/LED/switch. Positions two-view from references/xotic-ep-booster_measurements.md; OUTPUT z and jack/power y flagged provisional there. Print is vector textLabels (no full-top decal, so validate CHECK B skips); the EP/-booster hand script is approximated with the library script face. Real clear knob and blue LED are retinted locally by xotic-ep-booster.html (library knob is opaque black, library LED is red) - reusable clear-knob/blue-LED builders are reported as shared needs, parts.js untouched.
